pick_word.subtitle: Don't get the girls mixed up!
Don't let Hector's friends see him get upset!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would make the cutest couple?
Have you ever cheated on a boyfriend or girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mona, Porscha, it's really great to see you both.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Porscha, thanks for coming all the way over here. That's a long trip from the Wilson side of town.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: No trouble at all.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Mona, you came even though you're immersed in studying for the community theatre production of 'Much Fondue About Nothing'.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Yes... Yes, I perhaps should be practicing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, after we broke up, I do remember you saying how important it was that you focus on your acting. I would `hate` to stand in your way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, after we broke up, I do remember you saying how important it was that you focus on your acting. I would [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] to stand in your way.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You're... You're right! I did resolve to end all frivilous dalliances and devote myself to my craft.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I cannot believe I allowed myself to be distracted! Where is Brendan? As a fellow actor, he should've known better than to invite me to a `party` in the middle of acting season!
nodes.text_bbcode: I cannot believe I allowed myself to be distracted! Where is Brendan? As a fellow actor, he should've known better than to invite me to a [color=#3b78e2][i]party[/i][/color] in the middle of acting season!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Acting season?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Every season is acting season to Mona...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I must be gone. Hector, it was delightful to see you, but I haven't the time for a romantic interest at the moment, or for any social distractions.
Mona exits stage right.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Finally! I thought she'd never leave.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Now it's just you and me...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, uh, Porscha. How's the acting going?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I'm not an actress.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: What?! You're confusing me with this scullery maid?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why is this so familiar... Oh, man. Alexei's party! That's when Mona broke up with me, right?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `I` broke up with you at Alexei's party!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] broke up with you at Alexei's party!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I was only there for that great float caper that we pulled off.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: This is intolerable.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Goodbye, Hector. I hope, for your sake, that our paths never again cross.
Mona storms off.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I can't believe you mixed up the two of us...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh. Yeah, that's really awkward. I bet you want to storm off now too, huh?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know. Most guys fall madly in love with me. It's kind of refreshing to find out that there's someone like you.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hector! Come back over here! Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess I better do some damage control.
And so...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: So, Hector, I hear you're single right now. I bet that means you're going to need someone to kiss at midnight.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I suppose it's good that `I'm` here to take up that role.
nodes.text_bbcode: I suppose it's good that [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] here to take up that role.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yeah, right. Like Hector would ever choose `you` over `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, right. Like Hector would ever choose [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] over [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...
Hector spots Amanda watching him from across the room...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh man, this looks bad.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wouldn't you ladies like to stop arguing and... Uh... Have some beef stroganoff? Or some pavlova. That's a dessert... I think.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Stop trying to change the subject, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hector, Daaahling, please dismiss this understudy.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Aren't you the girl who stormed into Alexei's party? Give it a rest, drama queen.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, talking to two ex-girlfriends. No big deal. Just need to keep my facts straight, make a little small talk, and get out of here...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Before Amanda gets the wrong idea.

rounds.subtitle: Don't get the girls mixed up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not going to be easy... This is a total mess you got us in.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I saw this on a sitcom once. All we need is a couple of wigs, some ice cream, and, hey, do you know if there's a circus in town?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hector, I don't want to get mixed up in some stupid scheme tonight.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not a stupid scheme. We'll figure it out. We'll make it work.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, `we'll` make it work?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#e23b3b][i]we'll[/i][/color] make it work?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: First, you go off on me for a perfectly reasonable mistake, and then you try to draft me into helping you fix it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know what, Hector? I think we'll `both` be better off if you leave me out of all of your ridiculous plans!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what, Hector? I think we'll [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] be better off if you leave me out of all of your ridiculous plans!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whatever, man. I'm out of here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Take care of your party yourself!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess I shouldn't have been so hard on Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, man. You're just not ready for the big leagues.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's... That's...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: For once, I'm not going to be stuck trying to keep control of a party, or trying to sell a bunch of tickets for the school play, or figuring out how to get home from the Wilson High side of town!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I'm only responsible for `some` of those things!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'm only responsible for [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] of those things!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyway, thanks, Hector! I'm going to go hang out with Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How about that? Brendan needed a break from all of the drama...
Just then, the doorbell rings...
Hector opens the door...
And a beautiful, blonde girl walks in.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hi, Hector! It's been too, too long.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Porscha?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Some nerdy kid named Brendan said you were having a party... And you know I'd never miss one of your parties!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What's wrong? Aren't you happy to see me?
The doorbell rings again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've got to answer the door!
Hector opens the door, and Mona comes in!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hector, Daaaahling! Brendan told me I really had to attend this soiree to learn more about Russian culture, and I must say I'm glad I listened to his advice.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Now if the school ever does a production of 'A Doll's Dwelling Place', I'll be prepared to play the lead!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, one second, ladies.
Hector finds Brendan and drags him into his room.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude! What gives? Did you honestly invite `two` of my crazy ex-girlfriends to this party?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude! What gives? Did you honestly invite [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] of my crazy ex-girlfriends to this party?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, don't blame me. You had so many notes next to the girls in that book... How could I figure all of that out?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Crazy ex-girlfriends are clearly marked with the skull-and-crossbones!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... I thought that meant they were goth-friendly. And, you know, Dinah doesn't really have any goth friends, so I thought...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know Mona's not a goth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: To be fair, Mona totally went goth when she was rehearsing for her roles in 'Vampires: The Musical' and 'Once Upon a Coffin'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Besides, I didn't know you dated Porscha. Doesn't she try to make out with everyone? This one time I was on the Wilson High side of town, and...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, Paula. A guy like me needs to be free to go where the wind blows.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't let myself be held down by one girl.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just not that kind of guy.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmm... You might be right about that. Your popularity is mostly tied to your womanizing.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you weren't chasing after every girl in sight with slightly amusing pick-up lines, your popularity would plummet.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly. I'm a free spirit! A wild stallion! I can't be tied down!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. Let's get out of here. We've got to find another popular guy...
Paula goes over to the other side of the room to talk to the guys there, but Amanda hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, `man!` Amanda thinks I meant all of that about being a wild stallion!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#e23b3b][i]man![/i][/color] Amanda thinks I meant all of that about being a wild stallion!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, Amanda, I didn't mean that I'd `never` want to date someone, I mean, if someone special came along...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, Amanda, I didn't mean that I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] want to date someone, I mean, if someone special came along...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sniffle... Yeah... I guess it would have to be a really special girl to make you want to date her.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I mean, not just some stupid rich girl with red hair and bad grades and mean friends...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait a second, that's not what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda! I said we were going to talk to hot guys!
Paula pulls Amanda away.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Stupid, stupid, stupid! How could I say that in front of Amanda? Now she's going to think I'm totally sleazy.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: No one turns me down... No one!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. I'm not saying you're not totally hot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The problem is... Um... You dated Andy!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What does that have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, Andy and I go way back. Waaay back. He'd never forgive me if I went out with his girl.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You don't want to break the kid's heart, do you?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmph. I guess I don't want to start any more drama that Taylor could capitalize on...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. Let's go find some other popular guy for me to date.
Paula walks off, but Amanda lingers for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, you're not... Friends with Zach, are you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Zach? No way! Barely even know the guy.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So you'd... You'd date someone who dated Zach?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, that's not exactly one of my requirements, but...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Amanda! I said we're going to go talk to hot guys!
Paula pulls Amanda away.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, that was good. Maybe... Maybe Amanda would actually go out with me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you know what, Brendan? This time, while you're talking to the girls, I'll go get the snacks.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That way I can get some stuff I know Amanda will like...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, we better get to work!
That night at the party, kids from school pack Hector's house, but Hector's waiting for one person in particular...
As guests fill up the room, Hector is in the living room arranging nesting Russian dolls, fur hats, and Russian food.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, cool party, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And the food is so culturally accurate! This borscht is great, and the beef stroganoff looks amazing!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Not to mention delicious.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just glad you're all having a good time.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, Russian New Years is going to be awesome... Now I just need to see if Amanda's here yet.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Hey! When did you get here?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor and I got here a few minutes ago. All these decorations are so cool! Happy Russian New Year's Eve!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Er, right! Happy Russian New Year's Eve.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm really glad you could make it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course! I love your parties, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Cool, cool.
Suddenly, Paula pushes past Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hector! There you are. I've been thinking...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: We should totally date.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'll be honest with you, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Ever since Taylor won the title of Winter Queen, I've been looking for a way to increase my popularity.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And I finally figured it out! I just need a popular boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And, well, here you are.

options.label: I'm not interested in having a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Call it a favor. Since you and Kat broke up, you've been all mopey. You need to get out there and meet some new girls!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow. Hector, that's really cool of you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It has been really tough getting over Kat. Thanks for putting up with all of my whining.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. No problem, man.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No offense, but you're not exactly great at talking to hot girls.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now that you're back on the market, you need to get a lot better, fast!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So you're sending me to talk to a bunch of hot girls `because I'm not good at it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're sending me to talk to a bunch of hot girls [color=#e23b3b][i]because I'm not good at it?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yup. But the only way to get better is to get out there and do it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh, maybe this wasn't the best thing to tell you right before you head out...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You'll be fine! Just get out there and do it! Come on, champ! You've got this!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I'll give it my best shot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Perfect!
Two weeks later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, do you know why I've called you here today?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Because you're throwing this weird week-after-New-Year's-Eve party tonight, and you figured you could get me to do all the dirty work?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If by 'dirty work' you mean talk to a million hot girls and invite them to our party, then yes.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh?
Hector hands Brendan a black address book.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This, my friend, is a complete list of all the hottest girls in town, listed by hotness and cross-referenced by curfew. Pick a few to invite tonight, and make sure they'll be there.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. I can do that. But why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because, we have standards to uphold. People are going to think I'm slipping if there aren't lots of girls at this shindig.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, no. I meant, why do you want `me` to invite the girls?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, no. I meant, why do you want [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] to invite the girls?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, are you really going to complain about the chance to talk to hot girls?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... I just thought you'd usually want to handle the girls yourself and send me to get food or something...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, to be totally honest, I thought...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, you aren't! What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm... A sixth Russian?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I speak Russian?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not true.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've been to Russia.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, you watched that James Bomb movie, 'From Russia with Ambivalence'. That doesn't count.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, okay. So I'm not exactly an expert on Russia. I just had to delay the party.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's for a girl, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, because... Uh... I've got to go.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just come to the party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, man. Do you really want to have a boring old New Year's Eve party on the same day every year?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or do you want to have a `crazy`, totally `new` Russian New Year's Eve party on a whole new night?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or do you want to have a [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy[/i][/color], totally [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] Russian New Year's Eve party on a whole new night?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's uncharted party territory! We'll be pioneers in party history! They'll be writing us into party textbooks in no time!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When they teach classes about party-ology, they'll be talking about us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. I guess I see your point...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See you at the party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Think about it... New Year's Eve is the one night of the year when it's okay to kiss anyone you want without any explanations.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It won't matter if she's with Zach... She can still kiss me. If she wants to, I mean.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't get it, Hector. You and Amanda have made out, like, at least a dozen times.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Obviously, she's into you. Why don't you do something about it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not that easy.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've kissed a lot of girls that I wasn't ready to start dating.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What if that's how Amanda feels?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Besides... If Amanda wanted to get with me, she'd break up with that male-model wannabe.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense. But, Hector, keep in mind that sometimes things aren't that simple.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And for the record, you might want to come up with a better story than this Russian New Year's Party. I don't think the rest of the school is going to buy it as easily as Amanda did.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh, no way! People are totally gullible. No one's even going to ask about it...
Later that day, after Hector tells Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You want to have a Russian New Year's Eve party?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense. You're not Russian.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, so I wanted to make sure Amanda could come. Is that such a crime?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No... I mean, I know you kind of have a thing for her, but...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, why not just have a normal party when she gets back? Why are you putting off the New Year's Party?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I just think normal New Year's Eve is overrated. And, uh, you know, why not try to bring a little culture to our party-going experience?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, Hector. Did you forget what happened at the Winter Formal? I've kind of got it figured out that you've got a thing for Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh. Right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I don't get is why you're doing this delayed party thing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, you know how things are. I've got some stuff to take care of as the host.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But you're going to miss the countdown.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Eh, you've seen one countdown, you've seen 'em all. I'll be right back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... I'm not okay! I can't take it anymore! I have to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm kind of dealing with a lot right now, okay, Linda?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whoa! I had no idea! Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sob!
Hector runs to his room.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Russian New Year's Eve is fun!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The only thing is... It's too bad there's no countdown to midnight.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, not to worry. Do you think I'd let any New Year's Eve party go down without that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I recorded the countdown last week! Let me just start it up on the TV.
Hector starts up the pre-recorded countdown.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There we go. We've got fifteen minutes till midnight, so I'll fastforward a little...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Perfect.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! I hope they have fireworks! I love fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, the countdown! Everyone, get in here!
Zach pushes past Hector to stand next to Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: This is the best part of New Year's Eve! Ready for that first New Year's kiss, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? Where did Zach come from? I thought he'd be distracted for longer than that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't kiss Amanda if Zach's here to kiss her! Looks like this whole stupid party was just a waste of time.
Zach wraps his arms around Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There's nothing better than being with your girl on Russian New Year's Eve.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ugh, I really don't want to watch Zach make out with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I need to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hector, you're not going to watch the countdown?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... I... I...

rounds.subtitle: Don't let Hector's friends see him get upset!
Don't let Hector's friends see him get upset!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm really glad you could make it tonight, Amanda..

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! Thanks, Hector. You're so sweet!
Hector moves a little closer to Amanda and puts his arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So I was thinking...
Just then, Dinah walks into the room!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, have you guys seen Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, no.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't find him anywhere...
Dinah goes upstairs to look for Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, um...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great... Now this is awkward.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well... Anyways, are you having a good time tonight?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, hey, do you want some `Gummy Mares?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hey, do you want some [color=#e23b3b][i]Gummy Mares?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You got Gummy Mares?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's my favorite type of candy `and` my favorite type of horse!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's my favorite type of candy [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] my favorite type of horse!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh. I know. You're always eating them at lunch.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee. You know, don't tell Taylor or Paula, but I still watch the Gummy Mares TV show!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I don't think you ever get too old for cartoons. Just between you and me, I've been known to catch an episode or two of `Blackwing Bird.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I don't think you ever get too old for cartoons. Just between you and me, I've been known to catch an episode or two of [color=#e23b3b][i]Blackwing Bird.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee. I used to watch that show every day!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'I am the menace that flaps in the night!'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: 'Let's get hazardous!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No way!
Amanda takes a handful of the candy and happily snacks on it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mmm!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, man. This is it. What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No way! You want me to help with the music?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Coming from the music man himself... I guess it's time for me to step up and spin some tunes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... Just pick a few and add them to the playlist, all right?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I won't let you down!
Zach goes into the den and starts looking through Hector's music collection.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice. Zach's out of the way, and as long as he picks something from my music collection, I know the music will be solid.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That should keep him busy... And I've got my chance to be alone with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you can pick a movie to put on or set up some video games...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh, I'm all over it, man. `All over it.` Where do you keep your fire?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'm all over it, man. [color=#e23b3b][i]All over it.[/i][/color] Where do you keep your fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fire?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, I've been practicing this juggling routine, but it's not as cool without the fire.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe it's better if you skip the fire.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, you trusted me with the entertainment. I'm not going to let you down!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Don't worry. You've got fire insurance, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe this wasn't such a great idea...
Smoke begins drifting in from the kitchen, and there are assorted gasps and screams...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Where's that bucket of water? Someone hand me a bucket of water!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whatever, I can clean up a little fire damage later. I can't waste this chance to talk to Amanda.
Hector marches across the room to where Zach and Amanda are talking.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: ...And then I told my personal trainer that I wasn't going to ruin my manicure by lifting weights today, so he'd better come up with a new way for me to work on my biceps.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Zach! Welcome to the party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh `man!` When did Zach get here?! I've got to get rid of him so I can talk to Amanda...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#e23b3b][i]man![/i][/color] When did Zach get here?! I've got to get rid of him so I can talk to Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, happy to be here. Cool party. Would've been here sooner, but I totally lost track of time at the gym.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, uh, I was actually wondering if you could help with...

nodes.prompt: I was actually wondering if you could help with...

menu.text: I was actually wondering if you could help with...

nodes.text: Hector hears someone come into his room. He turns and sees...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Porscha?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Yes, of course it's me, silly!
Porscha runs up and pulls Hector next to her.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Mmm! Come here, Hector! You're missing the party.
And soon, as the clock strikes midnight, Porscha gives Hector a big kiss!
Across the room Hector sees Zach kissing Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe this is the way it has to be...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe Zach deserves her. They've been together for most of high school. Who am I to ruin that, if they're happy together?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That would just be totally selfish.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess I better get used to the way things are. She's with him, I'm with one random hot girl after another.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually, when I put it that way, I guess this isn't that bad!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Porscha, did I ever show you the hot tub here?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hee hee! Let's go!
Amanda watches Porscha and Hector sneak off to the backyard.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's wrong, babe? Are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: N... No! I'm fine. Really.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Okay, cool. Let's get out of here.
Oh no! Is Hector really giving up on the one girl he has real feelings for?
Don't let this New Year's Eve party end on such a sour note!

nodes.text: Hector shuts the door to his room and takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well, this could have gone better.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yikes! How am I going to get out of this one?!
Just then, Howard runs in and steps between Porscha and Hector.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you're Porscha, right? There's a `really hot` guy looking for you. He said he'd be in the back yard. And did I mention that he's `really hot?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, you're Porscha, right? There's a [color=#e23b3b][i]really hot[/i][/color] guy looking for you. He said he'd be in the back yard. And did I mention that he's [color=#e23b3b][i]really hot?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Who was it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Was it Matt?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Chris?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Maybe Justin? Tom? David? James? Michael? Mike? Andrew? Jon? Peter? Wilmot?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Yes! One of those!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hmm... Hector, wait right here. I better go see who was looking for me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh. Nice. There's no guy looking for Porscha, is there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure if she wanders around long enough, she'll run into one of those guys.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, Brendan said you were in a tight spot, so I thought I'd help out. After the way you came through for me with that crazy Astrid girl, I owed you one.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, man.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just get out of here. Nothing's worse than facing an ex-girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, no more girls getting in the way... I'm going to track down Amanda `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, no more girls getting in the way... I'm going to track down Amanda [color=#e23b3b][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.title: New Year's Kiss
nodes.subtitle: Can love blossom on New Year's Eve?

nodes.text: Two weeks ago at Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, ladies. I'll be seeing the three of you at my New Year's Eve party, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be there.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course I'll come.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I'm going to be out of town. My daddy's taking me and Zach sailing around the world on his yacht so we can celebrate New Year's Eve in every different time zone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! How is that even possible?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's a really fast boat. But we'll be gone all of New Year's Eve...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, did I say New Year's Eve party? I, uh... I meant... Uh... `Russian` New Year's Eve party.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, did I say New Year's Eve party? I, uh... I meant... Uh... [color=#e23b3b][i]Russian[/i][/color] New Year's Eve party.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Russian New Year is a week `after` everyone else's new year.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Russian New Year is a week [color=#e23b3b][i]after[/i][/color] everyone else's new year.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! I'll be home by then! Yay!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great, great... We'll have... Uh... Those Russian nesting dolls, borscht, furry hats...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What does that have to do with New Year's Eve?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't over-think it, comrade!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll see you ladies in a couple of weeks!
Later that day in study hall...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, Hector. What's the deal with this 'Russian New Year's Eve' party? This has to do with Amanda, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

Hector sits on the floor.
Amanda comes in, quietly shutting the door behind her...
And sits next to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's wrong, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, nothing. It's a party! We're all having fun! Woo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Woo?
From outside the room, they hear people counting down...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Five!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Four!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Three!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Two!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: One!
Amanda leans over and gives Hector a short, sweet kiss.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Happy Russian New Year!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Happy New Year.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I guess we better get back to the party now.

Hector and Amanda walk back into the living room. All around the room, couples are paired up. Mallika is with Spike, Howard is kissing Linda, Brendan gives Dinah a hug, and Porscha is making out with Wilmot.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There you are!
Zach sweeps Amanda up in his arms and kisses her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... I'm going to go... Start up some music.
Amanda pulls away from Zach and glances back at Hector, but he's already across the room, looking through his collection of songs.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Happy New Year, baby!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Happy New Year.
Not bad! Looks like Amanda might have a tough decision ahead of her...
But at least Hector and Amanda got to share the first kiss of the new year, and the party was a huge success!

nodes.text: That's it for this episode, but before we go...
You played a perfect game! And that means it's time for a bonus scene...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh, let me tell you about this dream I had last night!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: First I was a fish, and I totally had to find this little fish that was lost...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. You have this dream every week. You've been watching 'Finding Screamo' again.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay, so I had this other dream where I was a robot, and there was trash everywhere, but I had to find the one surviving plant in Australia...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's from 'Wall-a-by'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh. Huh.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! I know! I had this dream where I was stuck in this house that had, like, a million balloons tied to it...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hold on a sec.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No offense, babe, but I can only take so much of listening to your dreams about stupid 'Pickstar' movies.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Let's just listen to the radio, okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector always listens to my dreams... I bet if he were here right now, he'd listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And I bet he'd never tell me that my dreams are stupid!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eep! No! I love Zach! Zach is my boyfriend! Love, love, love.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yup... No feelings for Hector at all... At all...
Poor Amanda... It looks like she's got a lot more on her mind than most people would suspect!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is totally pathetic. I guess I'll just hide out in here until the party's over...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, wait a minute.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is `my` party! I'm not going to let Zach make out with the girl `I` like at `my` party!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] party! I'm not going to let Zach make out with the girl [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] like at [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I want to kiss Amanda, then I'm going to!
Hector runs over to Amanda and Zach, just as the two are about to kiss.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, I can't pretend anymore. I really, really like you.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Dude! So not cool!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: This better be another one of your lame jokes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First, my jokes are `not` lame!
nodes.text_bbcode: First, my jokes are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] lame!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Second, no, it's no joke! I'm telling Amanda to leave you!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What? How? Why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because I actually care about her! And I know I can make her happier than you can!
Zach steps up and shoves Hector!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Not cool, man. Not cool.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, you did `not` want to make this physical, pretty-boy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] want to make this physical, pretty-boy!

nodes.text: Hector punches Zach!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector! Zach!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Please, don't fight! No fighting!
Hector and Zach knock over the table of food, then fall into the other guests!

nodes.text: Hey! Watch it! Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Please, please stop! I don't want either of you to get hurt!
Amanda bursts into tears and runs off.
